features.ret_open: close(j) vs RTH open / ATR (bars <= j)
features.relvol30: last-30m volume / median same window prior 20 sessions
features.p2_poc_rel: close - developing POC / ATR (P2 at slot b, bars <= j)
features.above_p1vah: share of P2 volume above prior VAH

audit.availability: every feature computed from bars with index <= decision minute j of the current session and completed prior sessions
audit.rejected: none needed (no box life / future node survival / final profile inputs)
audit.prefix_invariance: profile features verified in TEST84 (1,800 samples, 0 mismatches); price features read C/H/L/V[:, :j+1] only

target: net $ of the deterministic event at its horizon
models: PRIMARY HistGB; reported Ridge, ElasticNet, Logistic(sign), ExtraTrees, RandomForest, XGBoost, CatBoost, LightGBM (fixed presets)
ML_ADDS_VALUE: primary passes (folds >= 4/5 net, B excess > 0, SLIP4 > 0, remove-top3 > 0, plateau) AND T61 incremental >= +10 $/day and ret/DD >= T61
